name: Charrette Creek
places: New Melle Fire Protection District Station 3
about: The Charrette Creek watershed covers about 5 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 2 smaller watersheds: Middle Charrette Creek and Lower Charrette Creek. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 860 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 570 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Wolf Creek, Lake Creek and College Creek. All of its water ends up in the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
